title: From Ripple to Boundary: Deterministic Impact Boundaries for LLM-Based Software Evolution
abstract: arXiv:2610.36549v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The landscape of software evolution is undergoing a fundamental paradigm shift in the era of Large Language Models. As industrial software engineering increasingly transitions toward design-driven code generation, the bottleneck of evolution has shifted from writing code to maintaining deterministic consistency between multi-source design assets and the generated code. When a design asset changes, LLM agents currently lack a deterministic impact boundary to identify which code must be evolved, leading to two failure modes: hallucinating missing changes or breaking unrelated code. Probabilistic approaches, such as semantic retrieval or text-based diffing, fail to capture the structural ripple effects across highly interconnected design dependencies. translated_title: 从涟漪到边界：面向大语言模型软件演化的确定性影响边界
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.36549v1 公告类型：new 摘要：在大语言模型时代，软件演化的格局正在经历一场根本性的范式转变。随着工业软件工程日益向设计驱动的代码生成转变，演化的瓶颈已从编写代码转移到维护多源设计资产与生成代码之间的确定性一致性。当设计资产发生变更时，目前的大语言模型智能体缺乏确定性影响边界来识别哪些代码必须演化，从而导致两种失败模式：幻觉出缺失的变更，或破坏无关的代码。概率性方法（如语义检索或基于文本的差异比对）无法捕捉高度互联的设计依赖中跨结构的涟漪效应。我们提出了一种从概率性语义检索到确定性结构约束的范式转变。我们将设计资产形式化为知识图谱，并将其组织为基于内容的……（原文摘要到此中断）
tldr: 该论文提出将多源设计资产形式化为知识图谱，实现从概率性语义检索到确定性结构约束的范式转变，为大语言模型驱动的软件演化提供确定性的影响边界，避免幻觉变更或破坏无关代码。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes formalizing multi-source design assets as a knowledge graph, shifting from probabilistic semantic retrieval to deterministic structural constraints, thereby providing deterministic impact boundaries for LLM-based software evolution and avoiding hallucinated changes or breaking unrelated code.
